description: Put 1-50 limit orders (BUY or SELL at your own price) into the order book; they fill later when someone matches. For an instant trade at the station price use buy/sell instead. See them with my_orders, withdraw with cancel_order. Each entry is {item_code, type: BUY | SELL, quantity, price}. Buy tax is charged when a BUY order fills (on the execution price, like an instant buy); the broker fee is paid when placing. Every order runs through the normal place_order rules one after another (docked, funds, cargo, rate limit); the result lists success or error per entry, so a failed entry does not stop the others.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

orders.description: List of 1-50 orders, each {item_code, type, quantity, price}, e.g. [{"item_code":"RAW_IRON","type":"SELL","quantity":10,"price":12.5}] (a JSON text of the array is also accepted)

name: place_orders
